actual_author_read_scope: Actual reread of all available L0–152, publisher pages6992–6993 only; remaining pages are not available in this dossier.

claims.paraphrase: The stated biological unit is a 140 kDa tetramer of two DmpFG heterodimers; eight chains in the asymmetric unit form two biological tetramers.
Native and SeMet crystals differ. Three DmpF chains are NAD-bound and one apo despite crystallization with NAD; proposed domain motion and CoA-site interpretation are hypotheses.
A 29 Å tunnel supports structural channeling interpretation. Introductory turnover and acetaldehyde Km comparisons were explicitly unpublished data.

limits: No remaining-page, full-paper, raw-PDF, visual-figure or supplement inspection claimed.
This is separate from the 1993 biochemical preparation and does not prove exclusive channeling.
